entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Player Companion: Monster Hunter’s Handbook
entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your knowledge of strange life forms makes you adept at piercing their disguises and detecting their hiding places.

Prerequisite(s): Skill Focus (Knowledge [any]), Knowledge (any) 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): You can substitute a Knowledge skill for opposed Perception checks against creatures’ Disguise and Stealth checks, and for Survival checks to track creatures. You must have 3 ranks in the Knowledge skill that corresponds to the creature’s type.
